title: lnkiai/m3e-canvas
why_read: A niche design-to-prompt tool for turning sketched UI mockups into vibe-coding prompts, interesting mainly to those in the AI-assisted UI generation space.
analysis: This tool lets users sketch Material 3 Expressive UI screens in-browser and converts them into prompts intended for LLM-based code generation ('vibe coding'), bridging visual design and prompt engineering. It's a reasonably novel workflow idea but relies on trendy, unproven 'vibe coding' practices rather than rigorous engineering methodology. Useful for designers/hobbyists prototyping quickly, less so for engineers focused on production-quality code.
